body.condition: For every \(k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K\), every \(c\in\mathcal J_k\), and every \(u\in\{g,\ldots,t\}\), \[E_Q[Y_u(\infty,1)-Y_{u-1}(\infty,1)\mid G=g,S=1,X]-E_Q[Y_u(\infty,0)-Y_{u-1}(\infty,0)\mid G=g,S=0,X]\] equals \[E_Q[Y_u(\infty,1)-Y_{u-1}(\infty,1)\mid G=c,S=1,X]-E_Q[Y_u(\infty,0)-Y_{u-1}(\infty,0)\mid G=c,S=0,X]\] almost surely.
